# @stackline/proxyquire full reference

`@stackline/proxyquire@{{PACKAGE_VERSION}}` is an independent maintained
continuation of `proxyquire@2.1.3` under the MIT license.

## API

- `proxyquire(request, stubs)` and `.load(request, stubs)` load a CommonJS
  subject relative to the caller while replacing matching `require()` requests.
- `.noCallThru()` and `.callThru()` control whether omitted properties are
  filled from the original dependency; per-stub `@noCallThru` takes precedence.
- `.noPreserveCache()` evicts the subject and resolved explicit stub modules
  after loading; `.preserveCache()` restores the exact pre-call cache state.
- `@global` applies during transitive initialization and `@runtimeGlobal` also
  applies to later CommonJS require calls. Both can re-run initialization.
- A `null` stub simulates `MODULE_NOT_FOUND`; non-object stubs are supported.
- `createProxyquire(import.meta.url)` creates an independent caller-anchored
  instance for an ESM or native-TypeScript host loading a CommonJS subject.
  `.from()` is an alias of the same factory.

## Compatibility corrections

Temporary module records are detached without deleting unrelated caller
children. Extension handlers are restored only when the Stackline wrapper is
still active. Global/runtime-global detection is scoped to the active load, and
stub bookkeeping uses own keys and prototype-safe maps.

## Verification target

The release gate covers licensed upstream and deterministic differential tests,
cache snapshots, transient children, nested/global loads, extension handler
composition, the caller-anchored ESM-host path, TypeScript 3.9/current, Node
12-24, Linux/macOS/Windows, package contents, direct and legacy-alias clean
installs, coverage, package lint, and production dependency audit. The package
has one exact-pinned direct runtime dependency and seven external production
package nodes in total. `resolve@1.22.12` is retained because native resolution
collapses distinct symlink and package-export-alias request identities.

## Scope

Proxyquire controls CommonJS `require()`. It does not intercept static or
dynamic imports inside native ESM modules and does not control the ESM module
map. Use an ESM-aware loader when the subject itself is ESM.

Install: `npm install --save-dev @stackline/proxyquire`
Alias: `npm install --save-dev proxyquire@npm:@stackline/proxyquire`
Repository: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-proxyquire
Security: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-proxyquire/security/policy
